metadata.description: Connecting patients and volunteers with clinical research studies in Slovakia.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

footer.tagline: Clinical research registry for Slovakia · Privacy by design

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 10 characters long.
validation.ageRange: Maximum age must be greater than or equal to minimum age.
validation.icd10: Use ICD-10 codes such as E11 or J45.9, separated by commas.
validation.birthYear: Enter a valid year of birth (e.g. 1985).

loginForm.verifyEmailPending: Your email address is not verified yet. We have sent you a new verification link — please check your inbox.
loginForm.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

registerForm.checkEmail: We have sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.

participant.label: Participant
participant.description: Patient or healthy volunteer who wants to take part in research.

researcher.label: Researcher
researcher.description: Recruit participants and run studies. Accounts are verified by an administrator.

registerForm.acceptTerms: I agree to the terms of use and the processing of my personal data as described in the privacy policy.

verifyEmail.invalid: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
verifyEmail.success: Your email address has been verified.

password.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
password.resetSent: If an account with this email exists, we have sent a link to reset the password.
password.invalidLink: This password reset link is invalid.
password.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can now log in.

studies.empty: No studies are recruiting right now.

apply.title: Join this study
apply.privacy: The research team will only see a pseudonym — never your name or email.
apply.participantsOnly: Only participant accounts can apply to studies.
apply.success: You have applied to the study.
apply.error: Could not apply to the study.
apply.consentRequired: Joining a study requires your consent to processing of health data.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionHelp: Explain the purpose, what participants will do and how long it takes. Write for patients, not for experts.
form.resultsHelp: Shown to participants and the public. Share what the study found.
form.criteriaHelp: Used to recommend the study to matching participants. Leave empty for no restriction.
form.regionsHelp: No region selected = all of Slovakia.
form.diagnosesHelp: Comma-separated codes or prefixes, e.g. E11 matches E11.9.

dashboard.notVerifiedHelp: You can prepare draft studies now. An administrator will verify your account before you can publish.

study.enrollments: {count, plural, =0 {No participants yet} one {# participant} other {# participants}}
study.publishConfirm: The study becomes visible to everyone and matching participants who agreed to be contacted get an email (without any study details).
study.deleteConfirm: The draft and its questionnaires will be permanently deleted.
study.closeConfirm: No new participants will be able to apply. This cannot be undone.
study.verifyToPublish: Your account must be verified by an administrator before you can publish.

participants.emptyHelp: Publish the study so participants can find it.
participants.pseudonymNotice: Participants are shown only by a per-study pseudonym. Their identity is never shared with the research team.

questionnaires.empty: No questionnaires for you right now.
questionnaires.emptyHelp: Questionnaires appear here once a research team accepts you into a study.

form.submitted: Thank you! Your answers have been submitted.
form.readOnly: Submitted on {date}. Answers can no longer be changed.
form.intro: Questions marked * are required. You can save a draft and finish later. Your answers are stored encrypted.
form.noQuestions: This questionnaire has no questions yet.
form.submitConfirm: After submitting you will not be able to change your answers.

builder.choicesHelp: One option per line, at least two.
builder.title: Questionnaire title
builder.editWarning: Participants may already have answered. Avoid removing questions or changing their meaning.

errors.title: Enter a questionnaire title.
errors.choices: Choice questions need at least two options.
errors.rating: Rating scale: 'To' must be greater than 'From'.

manage.deleteConfirm: The questionnaire and all collected answers will be permanently deleted.
manage.auditNotice: Viewing answers is recorded and visible to participants in their access log.
manage.help: Enrolled participants see active questionnaires in their account.

profile.encryptedNotice: These details are encrypted and used only to recommend suitable studies. Researchers never see them unless you join a study.
profile.diagnosesHelp: Codes from your medical records, separated by commas, e.g. E11, I10. Ask your doctor if unsure.

purpose.health_data_processing: Required to join studies (GDPR art. 9). Lets the registry process your health profile and answers.
purpose.study_matching_contact: Optional. We email you when a new study matches your profile — the email never contains health details.

consents.confirmRead: I have read and understood the text and I agree.

withdrawConsequence.terms: Without accepting the terms you will not be able to use the registry.
withdrawConsequence.health_data_processing: You will not be able to join new studies. Data already used in studies stays with them as the law requires.
withdrawConsequence.study_matching_contact: You will no longer receive emails about matching studies.

history.title: Consent history
history.help: Every grant and withdrawal is kept as proof. Records cannot be edited or deleted.

dashboard.getStartedHelp: Two steps so we can recommend studies that fit you.
dashboard.consentMissing: To join studies, give consent to processing of health data.

findStudies.noRecommendationsHelp: A more complete <link>profile</link> helps us find studies for you.
findStudies.recommendedHelp: Studies whose eligibility criteria match your profile.

myStudies.empty: You haven't applied to any study yet.
myStudies.withdrawConfirm: You will leave “{title}”. You can withdraw at any time without giving a reason.
myStudies.withdrawn: You have withdrawn from the study.

myData.exportHelp: Everything we store about you in a machine-readable JSON file (GDPR art. 15 and 20).
myData.deleteHelp: Request erasure of your account and data (GDPR art. 17). An administrator processes the request; data already used in studies is anonymised.
myData.deleteConfirm: Once processed, your account will be deleted and you will leave all studies.

log.title: Who accessed my data
log.help: Every change to your data and every time a research team views your answers.

settings.notificationsHelp: Emails only contain a link to log in — never health details or study titles.

email_matching_studies.label: New matching studies
email_matching_studies.help: Also requires the consent to be contacted about matching studies.

email_study_updates.label: Updates from my studies
email_study_updates.help: New questionnaires, status changes and results.

landing.title: Clinical research in the hands of Slovak patients
landing.lead: Find studies that fit you, decide exactly what you share and see what came out of the research you took part in.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: Grant and withdraw consent any time.

transparency.title: Full transparency
transparency.text: See who accessed your data and when.

match.title: Get matched
match.text: Apply to studies that fit you — researchers only see a pseudonym.

results.title: See the results
results.text: Learn what your contribution helped discover.

create.title: Describe your study
create.text: Set eligibility criteria in a simple form.

share.title: Share results
share.text: Give back to the people who made it possible.

landing.trustLead: Health data is special-category data under GDPR. The registry is designed so that you never have to take our word for it.

encryption.title: Encrypted at rest
encryption.text: Health profile and answers are encrypted in the database.

pseudonyms.title: Pseudonyms per study
pseudonyms.text: Researchers never see your name or email, and studies can't be linked.

consent.title: Granular, versioned consent
consent.text: Every consent is recorded and can be withdrawn any time.

hosting.title: Hosted in Slovakia
hosting.text: Runs on our own server; data never leaves the country.

studyDetail.title: Study detail
studyDetail.description: Information about a study and how to join it.

login.description: Sign in with your email and password.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Join as a participant or as a researcher.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: We will email you a link to set a new password.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: Your account does not have permission to view this page.

notFound.title: Page not found

participantProfile.description: Information used to match you with suitable studies.

participantConsents.title: Consents
participantConsents.description: Decide how your data may be used. You can change your mind at any time.

participantStudies.title: Find studies
participantStudies.description: Studies recommended for you, plus full-text search.

participantMyStudies.description: Studies you have applied to or take part in.

participantQuestionnaires.description: Questionnaires from the studies you take part in.

participantMyData.title: My data
participantMyData.description: Your GDPR rights: export, erasure and a log of who accessed your data.

researcherDashboard.title: Researcher dashboard
researcherDashboard.description: Your studies and recruitment at a glance.

researcherStudyNew.description: Create a draft. You can publish it after reviewing.
